item.title: Heavy weed growth on pavements, Cambray Road SW12, 6th October
item.description:
Weeds and grass are growing through the paving joints along most of Cambray Road. The growth is lifting slabs and creating trip hazards, which I have reported separately. The road is not being weeded sufficiently frequently and with enough care. Please schedule a visit and confirm when Cambray Road is next due for weeding and the residents would appreciate a more frequent service. Photo attached.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cambray Road, Streatham Hill, Greater London

item.description:
